vulnerabilities: The 'Malacca Dilemma' — a term Chinese strategists themselves have used (attributed to Hu Jintao, 2003) — roughly 72% of China's crude oil imports transit the Strait of Malacca, a single chokepoint China does not control and cannot easily bypass at scale

Himalayan/Tibetan plateau terrain (average 4,000+ metres altitude along the LAC) imposes severe logistics, acclimatisation, and sustained-offensive constraints on Chinese ground forces relative to fighting at lower altitude

First Island Chain geographic containment — maritime access to the open Pacific is bottlenecked by island chains held by US-aligned states (Japan, Taiwan, the Philippines), limiting unmonitored naval and submarine transit

Advanced semiconductor manufacturing sanctions — domestic reliance on foreign lithography equipment (EUV/advanced DUV) and chip-design software from the US, Japan, and the Netherlands bottlenecks scaling of advanced AI compute and military-grade microprocessors

Financial exposure to Western sanctions — continued reliance on USD-denominated trade channels and SWIFT for international commerce creates vulnerability to asset seizures or trade interdiction in a systemic crisis
Aging population and shrinking workforce, reducing long-term fiscal capacity for simultaneous domestic spending and defence expansion
strengths: Manufacturing/industrial base — world's largest shipbuilding and manufacturing infrastructure enables rapid naval construction and ammunition production
Global supply chain centrality; near-monopoly on raw-material processing (graphite, lithium refining, rare-earth permanent magnets, polysilicon)

Anti-Access/Area-Denial (A2/AD) missile umbrella — dense array of anti-ship ballistic missiles (DF-21D, DF-26) and hypersonic strike systems capable of targeting naval assets beyond the First Island Chain
Eurasian overland transport corridors (Belt & Road Initiative infrastructure) bypass Western-controlled maritime chokepoints, linking Central Asia, Russia, and EU trade networks by land
Integrated cyber operations and electronic-warfare architecture targeting foreign critical infrastructure, satellite networks, and intelligence channels
